## Change

Describe the crate/release, tasks covered, and whether this adds guidance or corrects an existing entry. Link any related request.

## Evidence and validation

- Generator revision and agent/import/review details:
- Full bundle download or reproduction instructions:
- Verification toolchain, platform, and commands:
- Runtime checks (if any; distinguish these from compilation):
- Collection warnings, limitations, and source licenses:

## Checklist

- [ ] Exact published crate release and source identity checked.
- [ ] Findings and citations reviewed; upstream license notices retained.
- [ ] Every recipe has a current successful compilation record and recorded lockfile.
- [ ] Portable export includes both manifests, evidence, and provenance; no secrets or local runtime paths.
- [ ] `catalog.json` and README updated; bundle link is published or `null`.
- [ ] Registry validation, site build, and link checks pass (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Other crate releases and existing published archives remain intact.
